semantic_boundary: Literature-grounded and internally consistent does not mean physically confirmed.

source_classes.Tier B: Engineering literature or industry technical source.
source_classes.Tier D: Engineering assumption that cannot independently justify a strong causal claim.

sources.bibliographic_reference: ISO 13379-1:2025 official ISO standard registry page.
sources.limitations: Public registry page only; full standard text is not stored or quoted.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Diagnostics should use common concepts and structured interpretation; diagnostic communication should distinguish data interpretation from maintenance or fault conclusions.
sources.title: ISO 13379-1:2025, Condition monitoring and diagnostics of machine systems - Data interpretation and diagnostics techniques - Part 1: General guidelines
sources.topic: machine diagnostics concepts and data interpretation

sources.bibliographic_reference: Honda Global Motorcycle Aftersales Plus ONE knowledge article, 2025.
sources.limitations: General aftersales material, not the model-specific shop manual for this project vehicle.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Honda describes DTC/MCS information as diagnostic support for maintenance and fault-area isolation, not as a standalone physical root-cause confirmation.
sources.title: Why Choose MCS? - Diagnostic Tool for Honda Motorcycles
sources.topic: Honda motorcycle PGM-FI, OBD, DTC and MCS diagnostic workflow

sources.bibliographic_reference: Honda Global Motorcycle Aftersales Plus ONE knowledge article, 2026.
sources.limitations: General description of shop manuals; no model-specific measurements or pass/fail limits.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Honda presents diagnosis as a shop-manual procedure using inspection information and DTC/MCS data; therefore project RCA should recommend checks rather than claim component failure.
sources.title: Shop Manual and Parts Catalog
sources.topic: shop manual inspection, diagnosis and DTC/MCS use

sources.bibliographic_reference: Honda Common Service Manual, Honda Motor Co., Ltd.
sources.limitations: Retrieved from public mirror, not Honda's authenticated service portal; model-specific manual remains authoritative.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Honda service material treats battery/charging diagnosis as inspection of battery, regulator/rectifier, wiring/ground and model-specific procedures rather than a single-voltage conclusion.
sources.title: Honda Common Service Manual
sources.topic: common Honda motorcycle systems including battery, charging and troubleshooting

sources.bibliographic_reference: Jardine, Lin, and Banjevic, Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing 20(7), 1483-1510.
sources.limitations: General machinery diagnostics review, not motorcycle- or Honda-specific.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Condition-based maintenance separates data acquisition, processing and diagnostic decision-making; statistical indicators require interpretation and validation before maintenance conclusions.
sources.title: A review on machinery diagnostics and prognostics implementing condition-based maintenance
sources.topic: condition-based maintenance, diagnostics, data acquisition and processing

sources.bibliographic_reference: Knauf et al., IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics - Part B, 2002.
sources.limitations: Methodological expert-system validation paper, not automotive-specific.
sources.publisher_or_organization: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics - Part B
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Rule-system validation requires explicit cases, expert assessment and comparison; absent expert reviews should be reported as insufficient validation rather than inferred approval.
sources.title: A framework for validation of rule-based systems
sources.topic: validation methodology for rule-based expert systems

sources.bibliographic_reference: Verification, Testing and Validation of Rule-Based Expert Systems, IFAC Proceedings Volumes.
sources.limitations: General rule-system V&V source; does not validate any project-specific rule.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Rule bases should be checked for conflicts, redundancy, unreachable rules and testable behavior before use.
sources.title: Verification, Testing and Validation of Rule-Based Expert Systems

sources.bibliographic_reference: Hybrid online sensor error detection and functional redundancy, Sensors, 2018.
sources.limitations: Generic sensor-FDD paper, not ECU-frame-specific or motorcycle-specific.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Missing or stuck-at-constant sensor signals can be fault patterns, but confirmation requires redundancy, model checks or additional integrity evidence.
sources.title: Hybrid online sensor error detection and functional redundancy for systems with time-varying parameters
sources.topic: sensor fault detection, missing or stuck signals, functional redundancy

sources.bibliographic_reference: DENSO Auto Parts charging-system diagnostic guide.
sources.limitations: Industry technical guidance, not peer-reviewed and not Honda-model-specific.
sources.supported_diagnostic_principle: Charging-system diagnosis should check battery, alternator/regulator output, wiring, loads and OEM service procedures; voltage deviation alone does not isolate a component.
sources.title: Charging System Diagnosis
sources.topic: charging system diagnosis, wiring, load and OEM procedure
